name: Harriet Taylor Mill
shortBio: English philosopher and women's rights theorist who authored 'The Enfranchisement of Women' and deeply shaped John Stuart Mill's On Liberty, Principles of Political Economy, and utilitarian feminism.
centralQuestion: How can liberal utilitarianism realize authentic individuality and civic justice while denying women equal political rights, education, and economic independence?

keyWorks.title: The Enfranchisement of Women
keyWorks.description: Pathbreaking philosophical argument for women's suffrage, equal occupational access, and abolition of domestic legal subordination.

keyWorks.title: Essays on Sex Equality
keyWorks.description: Early manuscripts analyzing marriage law, custom-bound conformity, and moral autonomy.
